title: Bundle a teardown simulator into one offline page
description: Copies a teardown sim folder (main.js and its imports) into the asset and bundles it with upstream teardown into a single HTML page with three.js and fonts inlined. The page is a presentation deliverable, not a game-engine asset. Pass a sim folder with main.js, or a folder of sims with --set entry=NAME when the page imports sibling folders.
